info.title: Planable Public API
info.description:
REST API for managing Planable companies, workspaces, pages, posts and more.

**Plan eligibility:** new API tokens can only be generated by companies on the **Pro** and **Enterprise** plans. Tokens that have already been generated continue to work regardless of plan.

get.description: Returns 200 if the token is valid and has the read scope.
Returns posts for a workspace with pagination. Each item includes the same post detail fields as GET /posts/{id}.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: Filter by campaign ID, or `no-campaign` for posts not assigned to any campaign

200.description: List of post details with pagination

media.description: Up to 20 public image or video URLs, each max 100MB. Files are downloaded server-side from the provided URLs.

videoThumbnailUrl.description: Current thumbnail (cover) URL of the post video, when the post has a video with a thumbnail.

post.description: Creates a post in the specified workspace and page. Use `pageId` for a single post or `pageIds` to create grouped cross-page posts. When `media` URLs are provided for grouped posts, each file is imported into the workspace Media Library once and the same asset is reused across every post in the group instead of being copied per platform. The `notify` flag controls whether workspace members receive a post-added notification (email/in-app push); set it to `false` to suppress those notifications. Internal activity feed entries are always recorded. `notify` is not an approval request — use POST /posts/{id}/request-approval to notify approvers. The `media` field: Up to 20 public image or video URLs, each max 100MB. Files are downloaded server-side from the provided URLs. Use `videoThumbnail` to set a custom video thumbnail (cover); it requires a video in `media` that finishes transcoding during the request, otherwise the request returns 400 after the post is created — in that case, retry via PATCH /posts/{id} once the video is processed.

media.description: Up to 20 public image or video URLs, each max 100MB. Files are downloaded server-side from the provided URLs.

linkedinPdfTitle.description: LinkedIn PDF carousel title (`linkedinData.pdfTitle`). When set on a LinkedIn post with multiple images, also enables publishing as a PDF document carousel (`linkedinData.publishCarouselAsPdf`). Pass an empty string on PATCH to disable PDF mode and clear the title.

notify.description: Controls whether workspace members receive a post-added notification (email/in-app push). This is not an approval request — use POST /posts/{id}/request-approval to notify approvers.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of a static image that is uploaded and set as the video thumbnail (cover).

offsetSeconds.description: Offset into the video, in seconds; the frame at this position is extracted and set as the thumbnail.

videoThumbnail.description: Sets a custom thumbnail on the post video (the single video, or the first video for mixed media). Requires the video to be fully transcoded.

media.description: Up to 20 public image or video URLs, each max 100MB. Files are downloaded server-side from the provided URLs.

videoThumbnailUrl.description: Current thumbnail (cover) URL of the post video, when the post has a video with a thumbnail.

get.description: Returns a single post by ID including media URLs.

media.description: Up to 20 public image or video URLs, each max 100MB. Files are downloaded server-side from the provided URLs.

videoThumbnailUrl.description: Current thumbnail (cover) URL of the post video, when the post has a video with a thumbnail.

delete.description: Deletes a post in a workspace accessible to the calling token.

patch.description: Updates a post. Published posts are immutable and will return 400. The `media` field: Up to 20 public image or video URLs, each max 100MB. Files are downloaded server-side from the provided URLs. Pass an empty array to clear media. Stories support a single, non-GIF media item; submitting multiple media URLs or a GIF for a story returns 400. Set `archived` to `true` to archive a post or `false` to restore it; archiving removes any active schedule. Use `videoThumbnail` to set a custom video thumbnail (cover) from an image URL or from a video frame offset; the post must have a fully transcoded video (the first video is used for mixed media). Set `notify` to `false` to suppress notifications (email/in-app push, Zapier) for the edit activities created by this update; internal activity feed entries are always recorded. `notify` modifies nothing by itself, so it does not count towards the at-least-one-field requirement. It is not an approval request — use POST /posts/{id}/request-approval to notify approvers.

media.description: Up to 20 public image or video URLs, each max 100MB. Files are downloaded server-side from the provided URLs.

linkedinPdfTitle.description: LinkedIn PDF carousel title (`linkedinData.pdfTitle`). When set on a LinkedIn post with multiple images, also enables publishing as a PDF document carousel (`linkedinData.publishCarouselAsPdf`). Pass an empty string on PATCH to disable PDF mode and clear the title.

notify.description: When false, the edit activities created by this update do not trigger notifications (email/in-app push, Zapier). Modifies nothing by itself, so at least one other field must be provided.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of a static image that is uploaded and set as the video thumbnail (cover).

offsetSeconds.description: Offset into the video, in seconds; the frame at this position is extracted and set as the thumbnail.

videoThumbnail.description: Sets a custom thumbnail on the post video (the single video, or the first video for mixed media). Requires the video to be fully transcoded.

media.description: Up to 20 public image or video URLs, each max 100MB. Files are downloaded server-side from the provided URLs.

videoThumbnailUrl.description: Current thumbnail (cover) URL of the post video, when the post has a video with a thumbnail.

400.description: Validation error or post is already published

get.description: Returns the latest metrics snapshot for a published post.

200.description: Latest metrics snapshot for the post

404.description: Post not found or metrics missing

post.description: Triggers a fresh metrics sync for a published post.

200.description: Post metrics sync queued or deduplicated

get.description: Returns whether a post metrics sync is in progress and when metrics last synced.

post.description: Generates a client-shareable public link for a post. Idempotent: if the post is already shared, returns the existing link. Grouped posts share a single link across the group.

200.description: Public share link for the post

delete.description: Removes the public share link from a post. Idempotent: returns 204 even if the post is not shared.

patch.description: Sets zero-based grid positions for posts using the order of `postIds`. The first ID receives `gridPosition: 0`, the second receives `gridPosition: 1`, and so on.

post.description: Notifies the given workspace members to review and approve the post. Approvers must be members of the post workspace; for team-only posts only team members are notified. Optionally pass `levelId` to target a specific approval level on workspaces with multi-level approval, and `note` to include a message in the notification.

400.description: Validation error: an approver is not a workspace member, only client users were provided for a team-only post, or the post is already published

get.description: Returns the total number of posts across all workspaces the token has access to.

200.description: Total posts count and per-workspace breakdown

get.description: Returns campaigns for a workspace with pagination, optionally filtered by status.

post.description: Creates a campaign in a workspace. `description` is supplied as plain text and stored as rich text. Subject to the workspace campaign plan limit.

403.description: Campaign limit reached or insufficient permissions

get.description: Returns a single campaign by ID.

patch.description: Partially updates a campaign. Any subset of the create fields may be provided.

delete.description: Deletes a campaign and detaches it from its posts. Posts are kept; only the `campaignId` link is removed.

get.description: Returns all labels for a workspace.

post.description: Creates a new label in a workspace.

get.description: Returns the members of a workspace with their permissions, membership type (team or client), and approver status. Use this to map member ids to people when requesting approvals or interpreting comment authors.

403.description: Token does not have access to this workspace

get.description: Returns media uploads for a workspace with pagination.

200.description: List of media uploads with pagination

post.description: Accepts 1 to 20 public image or video URLs (each max 100MB) for async download and processing. Returns 202 immediately with processing status for each item.

mediaUrls.description: Array of 1 to 20 public image/video URLs to upload to the workspace media library. Each file max ~100MB.

get.description: Returns a single media upload by ID.

post.description: Triggers a fresh analytics metrics sync for a page.

200.description: Page metrics sync queued or deduplicated

400.description: Page type does not support analytics sync

get.description: Returns whether a page metrics sync is in progress and when metrics last synced.
Returns pages (social channels) the token has access to, with pagination.
Returns paginated raw page metrics snapshots for a date range.
Lists the competitors tracked for one of your pages. Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn pages only.

400.description: Page type does not support competitor analytics

403.description: Token cannot read this page or the Analytics add-on is inactive

post.description: Starts tracking a competitor for one of your pages, identified by @handle or profile URL. Capped at 5 competitors per page. Re-adding an already-tracked competitor is idempotent — it returns 200 with the existing row instead of creating a duplicate. Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn pages only.

400.description: Missing handle/url, unsupported page type, or the profile is currently unavailable

403.description: Token lacks the write scope, the Analytics add-on is inactive, or the competitor cap is reached

404.description: Page not found, or the handle could not be found on the platform

get.summary: Compare your page against its competitors
get.description: Your page and its tracked competitors over a window — followers, posts, total and average engagement. Own and competitor engagement use slightly different bases (own = platform-reported, competitor = scraped). Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn pages only.

400.description: Page type does not support competitor analytics

403.description: Token cannot read this page or the Analytics add-on is inactive

get.summary: Follower & engagement trend for your page and its competitors
get.description: Daily follower and engagement series for your page and each tracked competitor over a window. Own and competitor engagement use slightly different bases (own = platform-reported, competitor = scraped). Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn pages only.

parameters.name: scrapedPageIds
parameters.description: Optional competitor scrapedPageIds filter. Repeat the query param or pass a comma-separated list.

400.description: Page type does not support competitor analytics

403.description: Token cannot read this page or the Analytics add-on is inactive

get.summary: Top posts across your page's competitors
get.description: Top posts across all tracked competitors, merged and ranked by sortBy (descending), each tagged with its competitor. Competitors only — your own posts are available via /posts. Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn pages only.

parameters.name: scrapedPageIds
parameters.description: Optional competitor scrapedPageIds filter. Repeat the query param or pass a comma-separated list.

400.description: Validation error or page type does not support competitor analytics

403.description: Token cannot read this page or the Analytics add-on is inactive

delete.description: Stops tracking a competitor on your page. Re-adding within the cooling window restores its history. Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn pages only.

403.description: Token lacks the write scope or the Analytics add-on is inactive

404.description: Page not found, or the competitor is not tracked by this page

get.description: Lists the keywords tracked for a workspace, optionally filtered by type.

post.description: Starts tracking a keyword for a workspace. Re-adding an already-tracked keyword is idempotent — it returns 200 with the existing row instead of creating a duplicate. The response contains the keyword object only (no sync state); poll `GET /keywords/{keywordId}/sync-status` until the sync completes, same contract as `POST /pages/{id}/sync` → `GET /pages/{id}/sync-status`.

400.description: Keyword limit reached, brand limit reached, or type conflict with an existing listener

403.description: Token lacks the write scope, workspace is outside token scope, or workspace is a sample workspace

delete.description: Stops tracking a keyword on a workspace. Returns 204 when the listener is removed.

403.description: Token lacks the write scope, workspace is outside token scope, or workspace is a sample workspace

404.description: Keyword is not tracked by this workspace

get.summary: List mentions for a tracked keyword
get.description: Windowed mentions for a keyword, with optional platform/sentiment filter and sort. Brand listeners only return brand mentions. Mentions are returned as a curated, typed shape — common fields plus per-platform metric fields as optional properties.

404.description: Keyword is not tracked by this workspace

get.summary: Aggregated metrics for a tracked keyword
get.description: Aggregated mention, engagement, sentiment, and per-platform totals for a keyword over a window. Internal API-spend fields are never exposed.

404.description: Keyword is not tracked by this workspace

get.summary: Daily metrics for a tracked keyword
get.description: Daily mention, engagement, sentiment, and per-platform breakdown for a keyword over a window. Internal API-spend fields (costs/totalCost) are never exposed.

404.description: Keyword is not tracked by this workspace

get.description: Polls the sync job status for a tracked keyword. After `POST /keywords`, poll this endpoint until `status` is `complete` (or `removed` if the keyword was deleted mid-poll). Mirrors `GET /pages/{id}/sync-status`.

404.description: Keyword has a listener but no sync jobs were found

post.description: Creates a story on a story-capable page (Instagram and Facebook). Provide `media` as a single URL for a one-frame story, or as an array of URLs (max 20) to create a multi-frame story group (one frame per URL, in order). When a multi-frame story is created the response also includes `posts` (every frame, in order) and `group` (the shared story-group id and its post ids). GIFs are not supported. Media is processed asynchronously, so the `media` URL is typically `null` in this response while the upload is still processing — use `mediaId` with GET /media/{id} (or re-fetch the story) to poll `mediaStatus` until it is `success`, at which point the URL becomes available. The `notify` flag controls whether workspace members receive a post-added notification (email/in-app push); set it to `false` to suppress those notifications. Internal activity feed entries are always recorded. `notify` is not an approval request — use POST /posts/{id}/request-approval to notify approvers.

media.description: A single media URL creates a one-frame story. An array of media URLs (max 20) creates a multi-frame story group — one frame per URL, in order. GIFs are not supported.

notify.description: Controls whether workspace members receive a post-added notification (email/in-app push). This is not an approval request — use POST /posts/{id}/request-approval to notify approvers.

mediaId.description: Media library id of the attached media. Use with GET /media/{id} to poll its processing status.

mediaStatus.description: Processing status of the attached media. The `media` URL is only populated once this is `success`.

mediaId.description: Media library id of the attached media. Use with GET /media/{id} to poll its processing status.

mediaStatus.description: Processing status of the attached media. The `media` URL is only populated once this is `success`.

get.description: Returns comments for a post with pagination.

post.summary: Add a comment to a post
post.description: Creates a new comment on a post. Pass replyToCommentId to create a threaded reply to an existing comment on the same post.

patch.summary: Update a comment on a post
patch.description: Updates the text of a comment. Only the comment author (the user who created the API token) can edit it.

403.description: Only the comment author can edit it

delete.summary: Delete a comment from a post
delete.description: Deletes a comment and its replies. Only the comment author (the user who created the API token) can delete it.

403.description: Only the comment author can delete it

post.summary: Toggle a reaction on a comment
post.description: Adds the token user emoji reaction to a comment. Toggle semantics: sending the same emoji again removes the reaction. Returns the updated reactions of the comment.

get.description: Returns all workspaces the token has access to.

post.description: Creates a new workspace in the calling token's company.

403.description: Workspace limit reached or insufficient permissions

delete.description: Deletes a workspace in the company associated with the calling token.
